extracted.intended_audience: EPA communications staff and reviewers (Office of Public Affairs; staff preparing and reviewing Agency communications)
extracted.subtask_description: Agency stylebook giving standards to prepare and review EPA communications: guidance on style, format, presentation, and product-review compliance across most media (print, audiovisual, broadcast, presentation, exhibits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose — prepare and review Agency communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Stylebook to prepare and review Agency communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to guide those preparing and reviewing EPA communications products; functions as the central standards document for Agency communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope — guide style, format and presentation of EPA content
rubrics_metrics.description: To guide the style, format and presentation of EPA’s content and communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to most media including print documents, audiovisual, broadcast, presentation and exhibit work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope exclusion — does not directly address news media / news releases
rubrics_metrics.description: It does not directly address news media, such as news releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: News releases and other news-media-specific products are outside the direct scope of this stylebook and may follow separate guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with EPA Product Review system
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to EPA Product Review system as part of the document's subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications products should adhere to the Agency’s product review procedures and requirements (follow local EPA product-review workflows and sign-offs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Government Printing Office / Joint Committee on Printing standards for print work
rubrics_metrics.description: References the Government Printing Office and the Joint Committee on Printing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Printed materials should follow applicable federal printing and publishing standards as set by the Government Printing Office and Joint Committee on Printing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use AP (Associated Press) Style Guide as baseline
rubrics_metrics.description: AP (Associated Press) Style Guide is listed among the stylebook's reference subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt AP style conventions for journalistic and general usage unless the stylebook specifies an EPA-specific exception.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 508 accessibility compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act is listed among the stylebook's reference subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications products must comply with Section 508 accessibility requirements (e.g., accessible content, Section 508–compatible formats) as applicable to the medium.
